# Third-party components

Miyonos does not vendor third-party source code. Target packages include the
pinned SDL2 shared libraries built from `steward-fu/sdl2`; their license is
reproduced here. Host-side tests use only the platform C++ and Python standard
libraries.

See `RUNTIME-NOTICES.md` for every target shared library, its license family,
source location, and the additional complete license files staged from pinned
upstream inputs during packaging.
